---
title: "Descriptions (knitr)"
filters:
  - panzoom
expect-errors: []
expect-descriptions:
  - 'Say “hi”, then stop.'
  - 'Compare a, “hint”: true, and more.'
  - '{“a”: 1, “b”: [2, 3]}'
  - 'Braces } and ] and , “x”:'
  - 'It’s a “quoted” one, with \(\theta = \alpha_1\)'
---

Descriptions that look like more options, as knitr passes them: each must
come through whole.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: 'Say "hi", then stop.'
#|   hint: false
plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: 'Compare a, "hint": true, and more.'
#|   hint: false
plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: '{"a": 1, "b": [2, 3]}'
#|   hint: false
plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: 'Braces } and ] and , "x":'
#|   hint: false
plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: "It's a \"quoted\" one, with $\\theta = \\alpha_1$"
#|   hint: false
plot(1)
```
